prompt_en: An intimate photographic portrait of an adult woman taking a quiet break from Minecraft in a small bedroom after midnight. Minecraft runs on a desktop monitor, showing pixel-textured grass blocks, cubic trees, a square sun near the horizon, and a small player-built house with glowing windows. She sits in a desk chair facing the screen, both feet resting on the floor, her right forearm supported by the desk and her right hand resting on the mouse; her left hand lies loosely beside the keyboard. Her eyes linger on the little house, her shoulders soften, and a tired half-smile makes the moment feel bittersweet, as though this digital place holds a private memory. Her styling presents an adult contemporary Y2K look reworking platform footwear, denim, fitted layers, small bag and pearl cues: a silver satin camisole over a fitted white baby tee, baggy blue jeans, tiny butterfly hair clips, and wired translucent headphones resting around her neck. The platform footwear, denim, small bag, translucent acrylic and pearl-makeup cues appear through chunky silver shoes, a miniature shoulder bag hanging from the chair, and tiny pearlescent makeup accents at her inner eye corners. A closed flip phone and a few loose CDs catch light beside the keyboard. Cool monitor light meets a small pink bedside lamp, illuminating natural skin texture and the folds of her clothes. The screen casts a narrow blue reflection across her resting fingers, visually connecting the real hands to the luminous block-built home. A three-quarter side view keeps her face, both hands, and the readable game scene together, with the room falling into gentle shadow. Place her profile on the left and the glowing screen on the right, keeping the chair legs and grounded feet within the lower edge. The photograph carries the intimate, slightly grainy texture of a compact-camera diary snapshot.
